label: m1-baseline-f3-badboot-20261015
note: boot_b (flashed m1-baseline-f3, M1-7.3 upstream baseline) found sitting in a Q28 BAD BOOT when device came online 2026-10-15 16:22. Independent confirmation that Q28 survives on the M1 upstream-standard tree AFTER the E1b display-regression fix (PLL_SYSTEM_MUXES) was merged into the baseline. L1 signatures: 'command DMA timeout status=0x2200200' + 'bonded command DMA failed master=-110 peer=-110' + 'Failed to initialize panel -110' at 11.91s. dsi_isr=0 (no DSI interrupt ever fired). L2 storm: 834x 'ctl reset failure' + 1202x vblank/frame-done timeouts. FALSE-GOOD TRAP: card0-DSI-1=connected, phoc/phosh/wayland all up, backlight=160, crtc-0 intf_mode=2 and core_clk_rate non-zero - all 'normal' on a bad boot; verdict must come from l1>0 not session/connector (PITFALLS #251/#255). OBJECTIVE panel-dark evidence (no user needed): DPU core_irq frozen at 10 across a 3s window (delta=0) + dsi_isr=0 => display pipeline is not scanning out. Boot was NOT a fresh POR performed for this record - it is the 10-15 flashed-boot_b cold boot, uptime 1h58m at capture, no warm reset since (so reset_type=por). q28-watchdog was OFF (marker /etc/q28-watchdog.disable persisted from 2026-10-13) so the operational backstop did not fire - this is the 'bad boot persists indefinitely' mode, not the watchdog-recoverable one.
